message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a Murphy chest bed. Wooden bed frames fall under 9403.50 (wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom). But the ruling's reasoning says the principal use is in a non-bedroom, so it would go under 9403.60 (other wooden furniture), and the 10-digit code would be 9403.60.8081 (other wooden furniture, other).

Alternatively, 9403.91.0080 covers parts, but this is the complete article. Also, 9401.40 covers seats convertible into beds, which does not apply here.

I chose 9403.60.8081 because the description stresses use in a living room, family room, or office rather than a bedroom.

{"hts_code": "9403.60.8081", "reason": "A wooden hide-away bed that folds into a chest and is principally used in non-bedroom rooms is classified as other wooden furniture, not as wooden bedroom furniture, under heading 9403.60."}
